compute_lexed_ir_observation: compute a LexedIR observation dictionary from an LLVM bitcode file using the compute_observation binary
lex_bitcode_to_tokens: lex an LLVM bitcode file into a list of LexedToken named tuples with id, value, kind, and category
unlex_tokens_to_ir: unlex a list of token ids and values back into LLVM IR source text using the compute_unlexed binary
create_lexed_token: create a LexedToken named tuple with an integer id, string kind, string category, and string value
review_lexed_ir_module: review the lexed_ir module functions for lexing bitcode to tokens and unlexing tokens back to IR
